open_design_decisions.decision: Auth scheme for /api/tasks (API key vs wallet signature vs session cookie). Unspecified in this pack.
Rate-limit thresholds and burst policy for RPC and the agent API. Unspecified; operator decision.
Whether sign/submit should be removed from the public handler table or blocked at the proxy. Unspecified.
Admin password policy (rotation, storage, length). Unspecified.
Whether ledger full/accounts should be ADMIN in the table. Unspecified.

actions: Require authentication on GET /api/tasks (A-01). Until then, do not treat its response as private.
Proxy-block sign, sign_for, submit, submit_multisigned, channel_authorize, and simulate on the public RPC endpoint (R-01). These must never be reachable without a credential.
stages.label: Immediate

actions: Set admin_user/admin_password on every public port and restrict admin nets to operator IPs (R-03).
Publish the 403/401 refusal matrix (which methods refuse, with which code) so operators and clients can rely on it (R-05).
stages.label: Short-term

actions: Add RPC rate limiting with published thresholds and burst policy (R-02). Until a threshold is published, the limit is [UNSUPPORTED].
Add the same rate limiting to the agent API (A-01 follow-up).
stages.label: Near-term

actions: Add a per-method allowlist/blocklist configuration for public nodes (R-04).
Deprecate transaction_entry or implement it; note the websocket-only transport requirement for subscribe/unsubscribe in the table (R-08, R-10).
stages.label: Medium-term

actions: Align the ledger table role with the in-handler gate (make ledger full/accounts ADMIN in the table, or document the second gate) (R-05).
Reduce server_info/manifest fingerprinting on public endpoints (R-06, R-07).
Re-probe on a schedule and publish the results.
stages.label: Long-term
